title: The Demon Tailor
text: A demon tailor sits cross-legged on a slab in the Pit, needles in his mouth, a bolt of red cloth across his knees. He offers to mend your gear, good as new, better. His thread is made of screams, and you can hear them, very faintly, in his stitches.

options.label: Let him mend your gear with his screaming thread.

outcomes.text: Better than new, and it whispers, very faintly, all the time.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles his price down.

outcomes.text: A good price, paid in a small lie, which he stitches in with the rest.
He is offended, and spits out his pins, and tells his friends.
